references.text: The Lord commanded the Israelites to make tassels on the corners of their garments with a blue cord, as a reminder to keep all the Lord's commandments. This is the parallel text that gives the complete law concerning tassels (tzitzit).
The woman with the issue of blood touched the edge (the tassel) of Jesus' cloak, showing that Jesus wore the commanded tassels on his garments in accordance with the law.
People in the region of Gennesaret asked to touch the edge of Jesus' cloak to be healed, a reference to the biblically mandated tassels.
Jesus criticized the scribes and Pharisees for making their tassels long to show off, pointing out the misuse of this commandment.
The woman with the issue of blood touched the edge of Jesus' cloak, a parallel to the Matthew passage about the tassels on garments.
